Class ModifyWindowController

java.lang.Object
library.controllers.author.ModifyWindowController
All Implemented Interfaces:
javafx.fxml.Initializable, RequiresLoggedIn
public final class ModifyWindowController extends Object implements RequiresLoggedIn, javafx.fxml.Initializable
Controller for the Modify Window in the user interface, responsible for managing the interactions and logic to modify the details of a book. Implements RequiresLoggedIn and Initializable.
